name: Browser Read
description: Read this chat's browser tab again as it is now, or only the lines containing `find`: the quickest way to locate something on a long page. With card, also get the tab's live card, when the user asks to see, watch or take over the browser.
author: anything

find.description: Only lines containing this (any case); leave out for the whole page.

card.description: true when the user asks to see the browser: the reply then has this chat's card for your reply.
